title: Test BackendSetError::Other paths in all handlers
description: Every match backend.some_op() in a handler has a branch for BackendSetError::Other(e) that routes the error into the not_* response map. Currently these branches are mostly untested — the MemoryMailBackend only exercises SetError paths. A bug in mailbox.rs (Other routed to early return instead of not_created/not_updated/not_destroyed) survived to pass 12 review because no test triggered it. Add tests where some_op returns Other(e) for each handler that has set operations: mailbox.rs (create/update/destroy), email.rs (create/update/destroy/import), submission.rs (create), identity.rs (create/update/destroy). The MemoryMailBackend or a thin wrapper needs to support injecting BackendSetError::Other for specific operations.
